notes: Source wording kept; the wife's line split in two; the double meaning of 'not kidding' is the punchline.
title: Not Kidding

lines.text: You got a vasectomy without talking to me?
Are you serious?
Yes, I'm not kidding you.

notes: Source wording kept; the dad tells it in first person as in the source. Son is a kid, so vovochka (unnamed) instead of paren.
title: Spotting Cheetahs

lines.text: We were watching a documentary on African wildlife, and my son asked me:
Is it difficult to spot cheetahs?
No, I think they come that way.

notes: Source wording kept. The man speaks at grandpa's grave, then a cut to the road shows grandpa at the wheel and the screaming passengers right before the punchline.
title: Like Grandpa

lines.text: I want to die like my grandpa did, in his sleep.
Not screaming like the people in the back seat of his car.

notes: Literal translation, both sentences kept. Grave scene, then a cut to grandpa at the wheel with screaming passengers.
title: Как дедушка

lines.text: Я хочу умереть, как мой дедушка, — во сне.
А не с криками, как люди на заднем сиденье его машины.

notes: Literal translation, both sentences kept. Grave scene, then a cut to grandpa at the wheel with screaming passengers.
title: Wie Opa

lines.text: Ich möchte so sterben wie mein Opa, im Schlaf.
Nicht schreiend wie die Leute auf dem Rücksitz seines Autos.

notes: Source wording kept, told by the man in first person; the waitress is a woman (devushka in an apron, not barmen); restaurant guests are a crowd that laughs; close-up on the choking man before the punchline.
title: CPR

lines.text: I was at a restaurant with my wife when a waitress suddenly screamed:
Does anyone know CPR?
Even better, I know the whole alphabet!
Everyone laughed...
Well, everyone except this one guy.

notes: CPR/alphabet pun rebuilt per adaptNote: 'первая помощь' → 'знаю даже вторую и третью'; the rest translated literally.
title: Первая помощь

lines.text: Я был с женой в ресторане, и тут официантка вдруг закричала:
Кто-нибудь знает первую помощь?
Я знаю даже вторую и третью!
Все засмеялись...
Ну, все, кроме одного мужчины.

notes: CPR/alphabet pun rebuilt per adaptNote: 'Erste Hilfe' → 'sogar Zweite und Dritte'; the rest translated literally.
title: Erste Hilfe

lines.text: Ich war mit meiner Frau im Restaurant, als eine Kellnerin plötzlich schrie:
Kann jemand Erste Hilfe?
Ich kann sogar Zweite und Dritte!
Alle lachten...
Na ja, alle außer einem Typen.

notes: Source wording kept, dad tells it in first person. The daughter is a little girl, so devochka instead of devushka-ryzhaya. The teddy bear cannot be drawn yet (needs).
title: Mr. Bear

lines.text: My daughter was having a pretend dinner party with her teddy bear.
Do you want anything to eat, Mr. Bear?
In my best bear voice, I replied:
No thanks, I'm stuffed.

needs.description: a plush brown teddy bear sitting at a toy table
needs.why: the dad answers for the toy; 'stuffed' only lands if the plush bear is visible

notes: Pun rebuilt per adaptNote: 'набит под завязку' = both full after eating and stuffed with filling. Teddy bear requested (needs).
title: Господин Мишка

lines.text: Моя дочка устроила понарошку званый ужин со своим плюшевым мишкой.
Хотите что-нибудь покушать, господин Мишка?
И я своим лучшим медвежьим голосом ответил:
Нет, спасибо, я и так набит под завязку.

needs.description: a plush brown teddy bear sitting at a toy table
needs.why: the dad answers for the toy; 'набит' only lands if the plush bear is visible

notes: Pun rebuilt: 'vollgestopft' works for both a full stomach and a plush toy stuffed with filling; chose it over the suggested 'ausgestopft', which means taxidermied and does not mean full. Teddy bear requested (needs).
title: Herr Bär

lines.text: Meine Tochter spielte mit ihrem Teddybären Dinnerparty.
Möchten Sie etwas essen, Herr Bär?
Mit meiner besten Bärenstimme antwortete ich:
Nein danke, ich bin schon vollgestopft.

notes: Source wording kept; 'shit' softened to 'crap'. The son stays off screen on purpose: showing a little boy would give away the Monopoly twist.
title: Jail

lines.text: My son didn't cope well with going to jail.
He refused to eat or drink anything.
He swore at everyone and covered his room with his own crap.
lines.uncensored: He swore at everyone and covered his room with his own shit.

lines.text: After that, we never played Monopoly again.

notes: Literal translation; 'дерьмом' softened to 'какашками' in text. Son off screen to keep the Monopoly twist.
title: Тюрьма

lines.text: Мой сын очень плохо перенёс то, что попал в тюрьму.
Он отказывался есть и пить.
Он ругался на всех и измазал свою комнату собственными какашками.
lines.uncensored: Он ругался на всех и измазал свою комнату собственным дерьмом.

lines.text: После этого мы больше ни разу не играли в «Монополию».

notes: Literal translation; 'Scheiße' softened to 'Mist' in text. Son off screen to keep the Monopoly twist.
title: Gefängnis

lines.text: Mein Sohn kam überhaupt nicht damit klar, ins Gefängnis zu kommen.
Er weigerte sich, irgendetwas zu essen oder zu trinken.
Er beschimpfte alle und beschmierte sein Zimmer mit seinem eigenen Mist.
lines.uncensored: Er beschimpfte alle und beschmierte sein Zimmer mit seiner eigenen Scheiße.

lines.text: Danach haben wir nie wieder Monopoly gespielt.

notes: Source wording kept; the angry shoppers are a crowd that murmurs.
title: No Windows

lines.text: I farted in the Apple store, and everyone got mad.
It's not my fault that they didn't have Windows.

notes: Window link made explicit per adaptNote: 'no windows at all, not even Windows' so the turn to the OS comes last.
title: Нет окон

lines.text: Я пукнул в магазине Apple, и все на меня разозлились.
А я не виноват, что у них там нет ни одного окна. Даже Windows!

notes: Window link made explicit per adaptNote: 'kein einziges Fenster, nicht mal Windows' so the turn to the OS comes last.
title: Keine Fenster

lines.text: Ich hab im Apple Store gefurzt, und alle waren sauer.
Ist doch nicht meine Schuld, dass die da kein einziges Fenster haben. Nicht mal Windows!

notes: Source wording kept. The blind man (dark glasses, white cane) walks in, and right before the punchline the driver steps aside and the blind man takes the driver's seat.
title: Giving Up My Seat

lines.text: I gave up my seat to a blind person on the bus.
That's how I lost my job as a bus driver.

notes: Literal translation. Blind man in dark glasses with a white cane takes the driver's seat right before the punchline.
title: Уступил место

lines.text: Я уступил место слепому в автобусе.
Так я и потерял работу водителя автобуса.

notes: Literal translation. Blind man in dark glasses with a white cane takes the driver's seat right before the punchline.
title: Platz gemacht

lines.text: Ich habe im Bus einem Blinden meinen Platz überlassen.
So habe ich meinen Job als Busfahrer verloren.
